syllabus_topics: Integrated unicast routing: spanning tree (IEEE802.1D), RIP versus RIPng, OSPFv2 versus OSPFv3, IPv4 BGP versus IPv6 BGP.
Network virtualization: VLANs, MPLS forwarding and associated protocols (LDP).
Multicast routing: architecture of Internet multicast communications, IGMP, dynamic management of multicast distribution trees, PIM protocol.

Quality of service: degradation factors, performance metrics, packet scheduling and discarding algorithms, traffic descriptors, traffic shaping and policing algorithms, RSVP, IntServ and DiffServ architectures.

Multimedia communications: types of multimedia information, voice and video coding and compression, audio and video streaming: RTP, RTCP and RTSP protocols, and real-time interactive VoIP applications: SIP protocol.
Mobile and wireless networks: wireless connections, CDMA, 802.11 networks, personal networks (Bluetooth and Zigbee), cellular networks, mobility management, Mobile IP.
assessment_rules: The final grade is a weighted average of the laboratory component (45%) and the theoretical component (55%). A minimum grade of 7 is required in each of the two MAP45 exams, and a minimum of 8 in the theoretical component. Kahoots can contribute up to 1.5 bonus points to the theoretical grade. A minimum grade of 9.5 is required in the laboratory component, and no more than one unjustified absence from laboratory sessions is allowed.
